definition: the head of a university faculty
description: The great hall of an old university, with tall Gothic windows, stone walls and a dark wooden roof. A young woman in a black academic gown with red trim and a gold chain of office stands barefoot on a wooden desk, shouting with one arm raised while papers fly through the air and fall to the floor. She then shades her eyes and points across the hall. Behind her a row of staff in black gowns hold cardboard boxes, two people stand on ladders at a window and a dog stands among the fallen papers.
